description_en: Modifies the resource group to which a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance belongs
description_zh: 修改云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore modify-resource-group --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmyiu4ekp0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the generated token is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which you want to move the instance.

You can query resource group IDs by using the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html.
Before you modify the resource group to which an instance belongs, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158866.html operation to view the resource group of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
目标资源组ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html接口或通过控制台获取资源组ID列表。相关操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html。
修改实例所属的资源组之前，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158866.html接口查看实例现在所属的资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id
